_comment: The only hand-edited input to the generated artwork. See DESIGN.md.
_theme: Identity, in one place. KDE wants it in three metadata files and the installer wants it in a Go const; all four are written from here so they cannot drift.

theme.name: Vanilla Box Dark
theme.author: Sizwe
theme.description: A minimal, modern look — dark variant

_foreground: Text does not follow the tint. Warm text on a blue surface reads as a mistake rather than a variant, and holding it still keeps every tint recognisably the same theme.
_palettes: Surfaces only. Values are hand-tuned per tint rather than derived: a computed hue shift misbehaves at the lightness of the view background.
_accents: One colour each, driving both the shell's highlight and the KDE accent. Named apart from the tints so 'Colour: Slate, Accent: Slate' cannot happen.
_buttonStyles: Two treatments, not one with different values. Glyph buttons show a symbol always and gain a plate on hover; circle buttons show no symbol ever and gain colour on hover. Traffic-light colours are muted: authentic macOS values would be the most saturated pixels in the theme by a wide margin.
